rules.statement: A corporate body cannot maintain an action for ejectment of a tenant on the ground of reasonable requirement under section 22(7) of the Rent Act, No. 7 of 1972, if the premises were acquired by inheritance or gift other than from a parent or spouse who had acquired ownership prior to the specified date.
rules.supporting_quote: The respondent has acquired title upon the Last Will as a trustee and whether it be an inheritance or a gift, it is not one acquired by the respondent from a parent or spouse. The appellant has remained in 'occupation of the premises after the death of the testator attorning tenancy to the respondent in 1972 and has paid rent to the respondent as the landlord. He contended that in terms of section 22(7) of the Rent Act, no action for eviction on grounds of reasonable requirement is available to the respondent.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 22(7) of the Rent Act, No. 7 of 1972

meta.parties: Wijenathan v. The Bishop of Chilaw
